    (
        SELECT
            id,
            page_no,
            data,
            document,
            RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(to_tsvector(document), plainto_tsquery('What are the main components that contribute to financial growth?')) DESC) AS rank
        FROM updated_finance_20June2025_table
